name: Evercore Inc.
moat_justification: Strongest independent advisory franchise (brand, board access, #1 independent advisory revenue, ROE 16-56% across the cycle) but the asset is people: no recurring revenue of scale, no switching costs, and a ~65% compensation ratio means talent captures most of the franchise rent; earnings are the deal cycle (OE/share $21.58 to -$1.93 in two years).
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.5x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
BIG_NET_CASH: net cash is 2.1x normalized OE — part of the price is a cash pile, not the operating business; note it in the verdict
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier D (6.5%) vs bull-case tier C (10.0%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end
one_liner: Elite independent advisory franchise, moat 5/10 — but at $256.51 the price capitalizes peak-cycle TTM earnings in full; on through-cycle normalized OE ($9.32/sh) weighted IRR is 8.2% (Tier D), and it clears 15% only at or below $109.39.
moat_for: Reputation-and-talent flywheel: senior bankers win board access, execution reinforces brand, brand recruits bankers; advised on 5 of the 15 largest global deals in 2025, #1 in independent advisory revenue
Independence is the product: conflict-free advice bulge brackets with balance sheets cannot credibly sell
Diversification beyond M&A (restructuring, activism, private funds, record underwriting in Q2 2026); over 40% of LTM adjusted revenue from non-M&A businesses
Evercore ISI top-ranked research feeds corporate access and mandates
ROE stayed at or above 16% even in the 2023 trough year (fundamentals.json series 2021-25: 56.1/31.0/16.2/22.2/29.1%)
moat_against: Moat is people, not property: SMDs are poachable and client relationships travel with them
No contracts, switching costs or recurring revenue of scale (wealth management ~2% of revenue)
Compensation ratio ~65% of net revenue: shareholders keep only the residual after talent is paid
Earnings are the deal cycle: OE/share $21.58 (2021) to -$1.93 (2023) in two years
Bulge brackets bundle financing Evercore cannot offer; Centerview/Lazard/PJT contest the same independent mandates
